recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, high-contrast portrait of a male figure in urban attire, centered against a neutral light gray background, framed by bold, left-aligned sans-serif typography and a stylized logo in the upper right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with head slightly above the horizontal midline
Typography anchored to the top-left and bottom-left edges
Logo balanced in the top-right corner to counter-weight the main title
High-key lighting on the subject against a flat, desaturated background
coreInvariants: Subject wearing a white polo shirt and a camouflage patterned cap
Black sans-serif typography with tight leading

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, centered, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bold title text in the top-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left title, moves down to the subject's face, then to the bottom-left name, and finally to the top-right logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space around the subject's head and shoulders to ensure typographic clarity.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral light gray background for maximum contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for all typographic elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Camouflage pattern (greens, browns) and white shirt to provide visual interest without clashing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation background paired with high-contrast black text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights and sizes for consistency.
graphicDevices: Stylized logo in top-right featuring distressed/textured lettering

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, modern, and authoritative look of the original.
Provides similar geometric clarity and excellent legibility at small sizes.
Classic choice for neutral, high-impact messaging.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution portrait of a Black man with a goatee, wearing a white polo shirt and a camouflage baseball cap with a green brim. The subject should be centered against a flat, light gray studio background with soft, even lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold black sans-serif text in the top-left corner, stacked vertically. Add a smaller line of black sans-serif text in the bottom-left corner, partially overlapping the subject's shoulder. Place a stylized, distressed logo in the top-right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the background a flat neutral gray?
Is the typography bold and sans-serif?

mustAchieve: High contrast between text and background

postGenerationChecks: Check for typographic legibility against the subject's shirt.
Ensure the subject is perfectly centered.
Verify the light gray background is uniform and free of gradients.
Confirm the camouflage pattern is distinct and not blurry.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait centered + Neutral background + Bold left-aligned Sans-Serif + Top-right logo balance.
